_note: Secret Vault water timings. Times in seconds; distances in 1920x1080 pixels; rates in radians per second unless named.

water._note: rise_s: the fade-out, the water rising over the screen; the name fades in over name_in_s once the water covers the screen; the water lifts away from lift_at_s into the fade-in, over lift_s. Wave height (px), froth and churn (how fast the pattern inside moves) go from their calm value at rest to their swell value at the water's fastest; the pattern moves carry of the surface's way, so the water flows as it moves.

bubbles._note: bubbles spawn at about spawn_rising / spawn_covered / spawn_lifting per second while the water rises, covers the screen and lifts away; each rises at speed_min to speed_max px per second and wobbles wobble_min to wobble_max px at wobble_hz_min to wobble_hz_max times per second

name._note: the name bobs name_bob_px at name_bob_rate; each letter bobs letter_bob_px at letter_bob_rate and tilts letter_tilt_deg at letter_tilt_rate, letter i at a phase of i * letter_phase (times tilt_phase_scale for the tilt). It fades out as the water lifts it from fade_from_px over fade_over_px.
